text:
anya (eng-platform): heads up — we're seeing spans disappear when gateway publishes to async queues. workers show new root spans instead of child of gateway. anyone seen this pattern?

matt (eng-runtime): yep, ran into this last week with delayed retries. logs show no traceparent on message when consumer starts.

jess (eng-infra): question: which queue type? SQS, Kafka, or internal fanout? some transports map headers differently.

anya (eng-platform): primarily SQS + some GCP PubSub. example of what gateway currently sets as message attrs: 
```
MessageAttributes: {
  "traceparent": { DataType: "String", StringValue: "00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01" },
  "tracestate": { DataType: "String", StringValue: "congo=t61rcWkgMzE" },
  "baggage": { DataType: "String", StringValue: "user_id=12345,env=prod" }
}
```

matt (eng-runtime): SQS attributes look fine, but some language clients (and the AWS SDK) will coerce/normalize attrs. also attr values are limited to 256 chars, and some chars get escaped. baggage can easily hit that. when attribute is missing, our consumer creates a new root span.

simon (eng-sre): that's the symptom we saw in incidents: trace link missing on retries. sampling also complicates it — if gateway sampled=false and worker starts fresh sampled=true, traces look broken.

kevin (eng-platform): proposal: carry W3C `traceparent` + compact `x-rw-trace` attribute for baggage/overflow. `x-rw-trace` = "<tp>|<ts>|<b64>" where b64 is base64(JSON of filtered baggage). fallback to traceparent if x-rw-trace absent. keeps interop but protects against truncation.

jess (eng-infra): we should watch message size limits. SQS attribute string limit ~256, total message attribute size too. base64 might still be big. propose filtering baggage keys at gateway (denylist allowlist) and compressing small JSON then base64. also consider using protobuf with url-safe base64.

anya (eng-platform): agreed on filtering. we should avoid user PII in baggage. please add a gateway config for `baggage_allowlist` and `baggage_mask_rules`.

matt (eng-runtime): implementation note: add a `rwTraceCarrier` in runtime SDK that knows how to decode `x-rw-trace` and reconstruct the Otel context. that way consumers call `propagators.extract(rwTraceCarrier)` and we keep sdk changes minimal.

simon (eng-sre): security + retention: exporters must scrub baggage before export if it contains any userid/email. our retention policies should not persist raw baggage beyond 7d by default.
\otel-bot: Span exporter backoff detected for exporter:otlp-us-east-1 — export will resume in 30s.

kevin (eng-platform): rollout plan idea:
- step 1: gateway: stop sending raw `baggage` attr, start sending `x-rw-trace` with filtered+compressed baggage and `traceparent` still present.
- step 2: consumers: use `rwTraceCarrier` to prefer `x-rw-trace` -> decode -> set context. if only `traceparent` exists, use that.
- metrics: `telemetry.trace_linked_ratio` (count messages where extracted parent present / total), `telemetry.attr_truncated_count`, `telemetry.baggage_filtered_count`.

anya (eng-platform): action items:
- jess: prototype attribute encoder/decoder + proto/compression options (ETA 3d)
- matt: add rwTraceCarrier to runtime SDKs + tests (ETA 5d)
- simon: add alert for trace_linked_ratio drop and data-leak checks in exporter (ETA 4d)
- kevin: write RFC for schema and compatibility guidelines (ETA 2d)

jess (eng-infra): ack, will start prototype. I'll include SQS attribute size experiments and a small script to simulate truncation.

matt (eng-runtime): ack, will wire into node/python runtime libs. will also add a test harness that publishes messages with malformed attrs.

simon (eng-sre): ack, will add alert and a dashboard panel showing linked ratio by queue + by region.

anya (eng-platform): one more: please make sure tracing tests cover retry->replay cases where messages are re-enqueued after delays (we saw missing headers on delayed retries).

kevin (eng-platform): FYI: sample compact encoding idea: 
```
// x-rw-trace value example
// <traceparent>|<tracestate>|<base64(json)>
00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01|congo=t61rcWkgMzE|eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjoiMTIzNDUifQ==
```

matt (eng-runtime): small note: ensure we also record a message attribute `rw-trace-version` so consumers know how to decode and we can roll forward.

simon (eng-sre): and make sure the gateway masks any baggage values that match `email` or `ssn` patterns before encoding.

anya (eng-platform): cool. let's track tasks in the telemetry board. thanks everyone — sounds like a reasonable path to stop orphaned spans. I'll follow up with the RFC link once kevin posts it.

jess (eng-infra): thanks — starting now.

matt (eng-runtime): will open PR for carrier and tests tomorrow.

simon (eng-sre): will add the alert/metric dashboards after jess's experiments.

anya (eng-platform): thanks all :thumbsup:
